{"id":"0714602efd0d7ca28f2707c57ff371dd","type":"message","role":"assistant","model":"MiniMax-M3","content":[{"text":"# Re-reading the Problem

"You need to **wait in line for 10 minutes** to make a call."

The **10-minute wait** is just context about how long you stand in line — it does **not** affect the call's cost (since you're not talking on the phone yet).

The cost depends only on the **36-minute call duration**:

## Recalculating

**First 16 minutes** at $0.25/min:
$$16 \times \$0.25 = \$4.00$$

**Remaining 20 minutes** at $0.20/min:
$$20 \times \$0.20 = \$4.00$$

## Final Answer

$$\$4.00 + \$4.00 = \boxed{\$8.00}$$

The 36-minute call costs **$8.00** (the 10-minute wait is not part of the billed call time).","type":"text"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":18,"output_tokens":182,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":913,"service_tier":"standard"},"stop_reason":"end_turn","base_resp":{"status_code":0,"status_msg":""}}
